name: Camp Warsofsky
description_short: A 10-week summer day camp run by the Boys & Girls Club of Marshfield, with campers split into groups by age (5-6, 7-8, 9-11). Days include swimming, STEM, sports, arts & crafts and outdoor games, and there is a separate Junior Leadership Camp for grades 6-9.

refund_policy_summary: Camp deposits are non-refundable and non-transferable. Fees were due in full by May 1, 2026. Changes or cancellations cost a $30 fee and need 3 weeks' notice, or the week is charged in full. Late payments cost $50/week.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim or splash twice a day, weather permitting; staff include lifeguards. The handbook gives no swim-test details.
special_needs_notes: Families of campers with an IEP, behavior or accommodation plan, or other special needs are asked to call or email membership@bgcmarshfield.org so the camp can plan staff and resources.
